name: University of Bergen
summary: Research university in Bergen on Norway's west coast; its 62 bachelor's are taught in Norwegian, a few partly in English. English starts at master's.

ib.text: Study in Norwegian if you have Danish, Swedish or Norwegian A (SL or HL), or Norwegian B HL, at grade 3 or better: that documents Norwegian, and you apply through Samordna opptak.

notes: UiB's English-language filter shows three bachelor's (Chinese, Economics, Social Anthropology), but each says it is taught in Norwegian and English and is applied for through Samordna opptak.
Economics (samfunnsøkonomi) also asks for a maths grade (MATTE4), which any IB Maths course at grade 3 meets.
Samordna opptak's deadline has been 15 April; its 2027 calendar is not yet published.
